Einer der Tiefländer führte mich zur nahen Trollhöhle, um mich mit dem Anführer der Trolle bekannt zu machen. Friedenserweckt fungierte dabei als Dolmetscherin.  
  
Ich bemerkte einen seltsamen Glanz, der von der Mitte der Höhle ausging; sein irisierender Schimmer fiel mir sofort ins Auge. Meinem ersten Instinkt mochte ich kaum trauen, aber als ich näher trat, bestätigte er sich sofort. Irgendwie war es ihnen gelungen, an eine Schuppe von Glint zu kommen! Bisher hatte ich nur einmal eine mit eigenen Augen gesehen – Isgarren hatte sie von der Kristallkönigin selbst als Geschenk erhalten, aber er hat niemandem erzählt, zu welchem Zweck.  
  
Die Schuppe in der Trollhöhle ist von Wurzeln umschlossen – vielleicht hat sie sich schon vor den Trollen hier befunden?

I know you won't—can't—read this, but at the suggestion of a new friend, I am writing my feelings on paper and casting them out to sea. The chance this reaches you is slight, I know, but the small comfort that it might find your remains soothes my aching heart.

It has been 259 days since our fateful voyage. Since the storm. A whole agonizingly slow 259 days since you were taken by the ocean. Now all I can do is wish to go back in time, to be able to pull you from the tumultuous sea.

Your voice rings in my head, telling me it's not my fault. Still, I can't help but feel it is. There had to be something different I could've done. And while I miss home, I don't long for it as I do you. Even given the chance to go home, I'd stay here just to be close to you. Going back would just start the heartbreak all over again.

Forever grieving you,
Lyla

I always found it strange that the elementals here were not dangerous like the ones we're used to seeing. Isgarren's power is...a little scary, I think. To be able to control all of this at once while still keeping these Kryptis away. There's a sort of...calmness in observing them, like you can feel Isgarren through them. I suppose he didn't leave us to our own devices, in his own way. Distant, but mindful. And powerful.  

The people of Garenhoff have no idea... Fractal or no, they relied on the Wizard's Tower for comfort. Safety. I feel for them, especially now that their reality is blended with ours. I wish we could just take them to our Garenhoff, show them that there's nothing to fear anymore. But I know it's not that easy...  

We lost the Bastion of the Celestial to the Kryptis today—they've managed to breach Amnytas. Which means they're getting closer to the fractals. They're defenseless without us, but... Isgarren still refuses to ask for aid. Mabon is beside himself.

Attention Heroes!
To celebrate the seventh anniversary of Guild Wars 2, an extra bounty has been placed on champion-rank enemies fought in Central Tyria. Champions defeated before 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) on Tuesday, August 27 in various regions of Kryta, the Shiverpeaks, Ascalon, the Maguuma Jungle, and Orr will grant you Champion Marks, which can be traded with Consortium officers in major cities for Bonus Boxes of Goods. Additionally, if the community defeats enough of these champions, all participants will be granted bonus rewards. See Bonus Events in the Achievements tab of the Hero panel for more info. Participants will have until 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) on September 9 to claim their community-goal rewards.
Happy hunting!
